Wonderful staff, equal to their delicious beer
Nov 2018
Shout out to Chang and Annie - Vietnam is not always known for its hospitality, but you guys are a very welcome and tasty addition to the area.
Chang can make great conversation while making you feel super comfortable, and Annie will not hesitate to bring out a platter of tasters for you.
If you want a tasty craft drop, I recommend stopping in - there are enough taps to satisfy everyone. If you just need a beer away from the hectic backpacker area, this will also suit well - C-Brewmaster is only 30 metres off the street, but a world away. If you want the best of both worlds, take a seat on the balcony. 
Thanks guys, there was a reason I came back 2 nights in a row: good beer and good hospitality.

Small and intimate
Oct 2018 • Solo
I went in to buy some beers to take back home as christmas gifts. I don't drink beers myself, but found it pretty easy to choose a large variety. The menu have a description of the beers (what they were made of and taste).
I don't think it was hard to find (I read somewhere that it was), if you have some sort of understanding of Vietnamese addresses. 57/4 bui vien is 57 bui vien and 4 stands for "off the street" (often alleys).
When I was there, it was 3-4 girls working and at least one had good English.
They also had ladies offers of 10-20% off depending on group size.

New location on Bui Vien in the backpacker area
Jul 2018 • Solo
Great craft beer! In the heart of the action on Bui Vien St. Great variety of beers, IPAs, Pale Ales, Blondes, Ambers, Pilsners, and more. For the month of July they have buy 1 get 1 free!!! You can’t beat that deal. They have a tv and show the World Cup. Prices are already good and add in the 2 for 1 it’s crazy. Mellow vibe and a good way to pre-drink or just avoid the crazy balloon/loud music chaos. Head down the alley between ToPizza and Lost in Saigon and you will see the tasting room. Enjoy!!!!

Unique Craft Beers 🍺🍻🍺
Jun 2018 • Couples
Here you have a local, yet modern craft beer place to rest and chill over some truly unique beers with intriguing flavors and contents. 

We had a great time here drinking and trying the beers, of which I highly recommend anyone trying the following 2 beers:
- Vietnamese Iced Coffee Beer 
- The Mad King Pale Ale

Really liked the decor and chilled atmosphere with all the modern signage. The lady that served us was very polite and informative about all the beers. There is a 30ml tasting of the beers free of charge so that you can determine which is the one you want and I think this is a clever idea as the flavors are so intense and unique. 

Will return on my next visit for sure.
